# Conversation practice with a hosted tutor

A cloud conversation service can reply to open-ended language exercises and suggest more natural wording. The client sends the learner's messages to the provider, even if the interface caches the conversation locally. An account and active connection are required for new replies.

Use invented examples when exploring the service. Corrections are suggestions to discuss, not authoritative grammar judgments. Downloading the chat history does not turn future inference into offline processing. A dictionary and a conversation partner solve different learning tasks.
